newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize steady to weaker.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize steady to weaker.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was lower in good volume trade midsession Friday, on good harvest supply and good yields in south and southeastern crop areas, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Buenos Aires was steady at $108, but lost $2 to $106 in the southern port of Bahia Blanca. FAS elevator soybeans were steady at $307 in middling volume, with sustained demand from the crushers but no real novelties disturbing the market. Sunflower seed was unchanged in moderate volume. Buenos Aires sunflower seed was $230. Crusher demand is good to meet oil committments.
